Vendored dependency: fitparser 0.11.0
Upstream: https://github.com/stadelmanma/fitparse-rs
Upstream revision: fb82202b34d10c2166784db333d9d23a29b79a49
Upstream crate directory: fitparser
License: MIT; see LICENSE (Copyright 2020 Matthew Stadelman).
Generated upstream FIT profile: 21.202.0.

This directory contains the upstream Rust source and the minimum library
manifest. No official Garmin SDK package, examples, or upstream FIT fixtures
are included. Upstream tests that require those fixtures are omitted. Local
public-interface regressions construct original synthetic FIT files in memory.

Local patches:
- File headers consume the declared size (minimum 12 bytes), not a fixed
  12/14-byte prefix. The optional CRC stays at bytes 12–13 and validates bytes
  0–11. Unknown extension bytes are opaque, advance the data boundary, and
  participate in the final file CRC. A 13-byte header has no complete optional
  CRC field; its extra byte participates in the final file CRC.
- Component extraction rejects incomplete bit ranges instead of reading absent
  bits as zero. Expanded arrays contain only complete encoded components.
  Encoded zero remains valid, including at an accumulated-component rollover.
- Accumulated components reconstruct low bits against the last full native
  target or previous expanded component. Native anchors retain their actual
  scale/offset, and each array component updates the carry sequentially.
  Full native anchors decode before packed fields within the same message.
  The profile's accumulated targets are distance, total_cycles,
  accumulated_power, and HR event_timestamp. This is not an HR-only patch.
- KeepCompositeFields continues to retain the native packed composite.
  Expanded fields carry the actual encoded parent field number. Native source
  composites carry is_composite() even when no complete component is available,
  so packed 0xff bits can be distinguished from ordinary byte sentinels.
- FieldDefinition exposes field_definition_number(), size(), and base_type().
  DeveloperFieldDefinition exposes field_number(), size(), and
  developer_data_index(). FitDataField exposes developer_data_index(),
  scale(), offset(), profile_type(), component_parent(), and is_composite(). Profile metadata
  comes from the actual builder arguments; unknown fields have no profile
  metadata. Developer descriptions supply real scale/offset but no native
  profile type. Profile type names use stable FIT snake_case labels, including
  date_time and local_date_time. Added metadata is skipped by serde, preserving
  the legacy serialized field shape.
- PreserveInvalidValues is opt-in. It preserves scalar and wholly invalid
  fields as Value::Invalid, plus invalid array positions. Invalid timestamps
  remain invalid instead of being converted to the FIT epoch. Packed Byte
  values, including 0xff, are retained for bit extraction. Exact wire sentinel
  bytes remain the archive caller's responsibility.
- PreserveUnknownDeveloperFields is opt-in. It preserves an undescribed
  developer field as opaque Byte values with its developer index and field
  number. The archive caller can report missing-description warnings. Default
  decoding still rejects missing developer descriptions.

Default decoding remains unchanged except for the component bounds,
accumulation, and extended-header corrections. Neither opt-in archive option
is enabled implicitly.

Scoped verification:
  cargo test --manifest-path vendor/fitparser/Cargo.toml --test components
The public from_bytes regressions cover a 100-second HR anchor followed by
101/102-second packed events, native composites, zero rollover, incomplete
components, literal 0xff bytes, opt-in invalid presence, opaque developer
identity, scaled distance anchors, and carry between packed messages.
